summary: Dashboard time-series loses trace links after aggregation rotation
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that time-series panels on several dashboards lost clickable trace links (Trace ID -> Trace view) after an automatic aggregation rotation that occurred during retention compaction on 2026-03-04 23:00 UTC. The series values themselves show up, but the 'View trace' links are missing or point to 404.

Impact:
- AuroraFintech (enterprise) observed missing trace context on multiple critical dashboards used for incident detection.
- Several alert notifications fired without trace links, increasing mean time to triage.
- Affects prod (us-east) and appears to have cross-region fallout for eu-west dashboards that pull aggregated rollups.

Environment:
- Platform: Redwood Console (production)
- Time of first report: 2026-03-05 02:12 UTC
- Retention compaction/aggregation job (v2.7.4) ran at 2026-03-04 23:00 UTC

Steps to reproduce:
1) Open AuroraFintech org dashboard with 24h time window across service latency heatmap and top endpoints panel.
2) Click on an anomalous time-series point to open the trace link in the right-hand summary.
3) Observe click yields no trace or 404 in trace viewer; trace IDs present in panel hover do not resolve.

Observed behavior:
- Series metrics show values but trace link anchors (trace_id -> trace viewer URL) are missing or mapped to old index keys.
- Alerts evaluated in the same window show references to trace IDs in the alert body, but the links are broken.

Expected behavior:
- Trace links should map to live trace documents and open the trace viewer for the underlying span.

Logs & artifacts:
- Aggregator rotation log (agg-rotation-2026-03-04.log) shows job id rot-48712 completed with shard reassignments.
- Trace indexer logs during rotation show warnings: "trace-anchor-mismatch: shard-mapping-change detected for series_id 0x7f12"
- Example broken trace id referenced by customer: trace_id=9f4b2c1a (click -> 404).

Investigation notes (so far):
- Support reproduced missing trace links in AuroraFintech account and validated that raw traces exist in trace-store for the reported trace_ids.
- SRE confirmed an overlap window where the aggregation compaction job rotated rollup shards while the trace-anchor migration job was running. Hypothesis: rotation remapped series anchors and aggregator produced new series fingerprints; dashboard panels retained the older series-to-trace-anchor keys, resulting in stale link resolution.
- Related internal ticket INT-2204 appears to have a partial fix for shard fencing but was not deployed to prod before rotation.

Temporary workaround:
- We advised AuroraFintech to open the trace viewer manually by searching for the trace_id in the global trace search (works while we restore links).
- Disabled subsequent automatic aggregation rotation for their org's rollup tenancy to prevent further drift.

Proposed remediation:
1) Run a targeted reindex that rebuilds series->trace-anchor mapping for affected day ranges (2026-03-03 to 2026-03-05) for AuroraFintech.
2) Backfill fix: reprocess rollups to reattach anchors and rehydrate dashboard links.
3) Add a coordination lock between rotation and trace-anchor migration jobs to prevent overlap.
4) Ship a hotfix to aggregation-service (PR referenced) to make rotation idempotent with respect to anchor fingerprints.

Next steps:
- Engineering to run reindex job during low-traffic window (ETA 2026-03-08).
- Support to track customer impact and verify link restoration post-reindex.
- Postmortem to be authored after remediation.
